Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Secret Lair’s newest Commander deck, Angels: They’re Just Like Us but Cooler and with Wings, features five consecrated cards with angelic art from Scott M. Fischer and, for the first time ever in print, an Arden Angel from the 2001 video game Magic: The Gathering.

So unfurl your fiery wings, draw your radiant blade, and lead this empyrean vanguard across the celestial tapestry to rend asunder those shadows threatening to engulf the righteous.

Contents:
• 1x Foil Gisela, the Broken Blade // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
• 1x Foil Bruna, the Fading Light // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
• 1x Foil Archangel of Thune
• 1x Foil Court of Grace
• 1x Foil Commander’s Plate
• 95x Reprints (including 6x first-time foil reprints, 30x first-time foil basic lands)
• 10x Double-Faced Tokens including new Angel and Spirit tokens with art by Scott M. Fischer.
• 2x Double-Faced Display Cards
